senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גבב; cmp. גאה) to be high; to be elated.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 15a:9">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ המן וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>ג׳ לבו של המן</he>) Haman is haughtier than Ahasver (he dared what Ah. did not venture); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1056:6">Yalk. Esth. 1056</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sotah 5a:8">Sot. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא ג׳ הר סיני למעלה</he> and Mount Sinai did not rise higher (grow proud).
<cite ref="Taanit 23a">Taan. 23ᵃ</cite> a generation which was to be humbled <he>הִגְבַּהְּתּוֹ בתפלתן</he> hast thou lifted up through thy prayer, v. <cite ref="C00004"><he>גָּאָה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 55a:2">Erub. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שמַגְבִּיהַּ דעתו עליו כשמים</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="P00794"><he>עליה</he></cite>, ed. Sonc. <he>מגב׳ עצמו כשמ׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 940:22">Yalk. Deut. 940</cite> <he>שמגיס דעתו</he>) who exalts his mind in himself as high as the heavens (who considers himself very wise, ed. who considers himself on account of his knowledge of it as high &c.). Ib. 13ᵇ him who lowers himself <he>הק״בה מַגְבִּיהוֹ</he> the Lord will raise, <he>וכל המגביה עצמו וכ׳</he> and whomsoever exalts himself, the Lord will lower; ib. 54ᵃ; <cite ref="Nedarim 55a">Ned. 55ᵃ</cite>. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14 <he>מַגְבִּיהִים פניהם</he> lifted their faces up; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Challah 3:1">Ḥall. III, 1</cite> <he>מַגְבַּהַת חלתה</he> she lifts up (dedicates) the priest’s share; v., however, <cite ref="C00047"><he>גָּבָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to take up a lost object in order to take possession of it.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 8a:4">B. Mets. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>המגביה מציאה לחבירו וכ׳</he> if one takes up an object in behalf of his neighbor; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 10a:3">ib. 10ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Beitzah 39b">Bets. 39ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.

Sot. 47ᵇ שפלים הוּגְבָּהוּ the low have been raised. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 5; Lev. R. s. 8 בלשון זה ה׳ with the word zeh (Lev. VI, 13) has he (Aaron) been raised.—Part. מוּגְבַּהּ, f. מוּגְבַּהַת. Y. Shebu. I, 32ᵈ bot. what means שְׂאֵת (Lev. XIII, 2) מוגבהת a raised spot (Sifra Thazr., Neg. ch. I מובהקת, corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְגַּבֵּהַּ to be elated, boastful. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 1 התחיל מִתְגַּבֵּהַּ והולך he beame more and more overbearing (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib.; Num. R. s. 18 מתגבר).
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 6">Num. R. s. 6</cite>, beg. <he>נִתְגַּבְּהוּ בעצמם</he> they were proud of their own selves.
